scenicChapters.title: Furka Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2429 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Furka Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: For 9 km this is Furka Pass, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

furka-pass.story: From Andermatt it runs 47 km to Andermatt; allow about 47 min of riding. The stops in between: Furka Pass and Hotel Belvedere. The highest point is about 2,450 m. Furka Pass is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
